design.title: Continuous-vantage training: uniform ±12 px translation jitter so training framings tile the ground instead of standing on the 24 m lattice
design.eli5: Until now the model studied its map only from camera positions on an exact 24-metre grid, like a surveyor who only ever stands on the gridline pegs — but the test, and a real flight, always look from spots between the pegs. Over a city that gap barely matters because every view is packed with unique landmarks. Over farmland, two fields can look almost identical, and the model was secretly telling them apart by tiny accidents of the fixed camera positions — details that vanish when the camera stands a few metres away, so it would confidently name the wrong field. Now training photographs from random spots between the pegs too, so the model can only rely on cues that survive standing anywhere — and where two fields truly cannot be told apart, it learns to say "not sure" instead of guessing.
design.hypothesis: Prignitz's gap to Berlin is almost entirely false fixes (3.75% vs 0.50%), and experiment 2 established that the confusions are rotation-stable, redirecting the era toward training-time disambiguation — exactly as that experiment pre-registered. The unquestioned training-stage assumption is that vantages sit on the exact 24 px lattice: rotation is the only augmentation, so the model has never once been trained on a translated framing, while every eval view (and every real flight frame) stands 8–16 px off-lattice. That mismatch is what lets look-alike fields alias confidently: during training the model can separate two nearly identical fields using micro-cues registered to the exact lattice framings (a field edge always 3 px from the crop border, a track always crossing the same pixel row), but those registration cues shift at a novel viewpoint, and the belief then lands with full confidence on the wrong twin — rotation-stable, because the twin resembles the twin from every heading. Drawing a fresh uniform ±12 px translation per position per epoch (on top of the existing fresh heading) makes training vantages tile the plane continuously — ±12 is exactly half the 24 px stride, so with the neighbouring lattice points every ground position becomes a possible training framing and the 8–16 px eval offsets fall inside the training distribution rather than outside it. Twins must then be separated by translation-stable features; where they genuinely cannot be, the existing bilinear tent targets (already built from the continuous position) teach split beliefs at intermediate vantages, so pooled confidence falls below the 0.3 threshold and the frame becomes an abstention instead of a false fix.
